what: Each Ofgem workbook opened in a calc-host HostSession, one insertion and one deletion of rows or columns dispatched as SkinIntent::EditAxis (each recalculated in automatic mode), saved with HostSession::save. Then: excel_same_edits is compare-structural.ps1, which opens the original in Excel, makes the same insertion and deletion with Excel's own Insert and Delete, calculates both it and the saved package in full and compares every cell of every sheet (formula text as Excel shows it, value, input); parts is compare-structural-parts.py, which compares what lies on the cells (merged cells, hyperlinks, validations, conditional formats, row heights, column widths, number formats, comments, notes, threaded comments, drawing anchors, tables, defined names) of the saved package with the package Excel saved after its own edits; the saved package captured in Excel (cargo xtask capture, a full rebuild) and compared (cargo xtask compare). Fail = mismatched + refused + failed or missing.
